skill.name: workflow-automation
skill.description: Design reliable workflows with durable execution, event triggers, retries, checkpoints, failure handling, and platform-specific patterns for n8n, Temporal, Inngest, and cloud services.
skill.summary: Build durable, observable workflows that recover from failures and prevent duplicate side effects.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive. The cited text describes an n8n schedule trigger in a workflow diagram, not operating-system command scheduling. No semantic security concerns or prompt injection attempts were found.

finding_verdicts.reason: The line is an n8n workflow diagram labeled "Schedule Trigger: Every day at 9:00 AM." It does not invoke the Unix at command or execute shell commands.

content.value_statement: Long-running automations can lose progress, duplicate side effects, or fail without alerts. This skill provides durable patterns, platform guidance, and validation checks for reliable workflows.
actual_capabilities: Compares n8n, Temporal, Inngest, AWS Step Functions, and Azure Durable Functions.
Designs sequential, parallel, orchestrator-worker, event-driven, retry, and scheduled workflow patterns.
Explains checkpointing, durable execution, and replay-safe workflow design.
Recommends idempotency keys, deduplication, timeouts, heartbeats, and exponential backoff.
Defines failure handling with alerts, dead letter storage, and recovery workflows.
Provides validation checks for common reliability errors in production workflows.
limitations: It provides design guidance and examples but does not deploy or operate workflow platforms.
Platform configuration must be verified against the installed product version and hosting environment.
Examples require adaptation for application types, authentication, data models, and service limits.
Payment, compliance, and production changes still require testing and expert review.

use_cases.title: Automate Order Processing
use_cases.description: Design a durable order flow with validation, payment, shipment, confirmation, retries, and deduplication.

use_cases.title: Improve Visual Automations
use_cases.description: Add error triggers, alerts, retries, and recovery paths to production n8n workflows.

use_cases.title: Orchestrate AI Tasks
use_cases.description: Coordinate specialized workers through durable steps, parallel execution, checkpoints, and result aggregation.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Workflow Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare n8n, Temporal, Inngest, and cloud workflow services for my project. My team, stack, scale, and reliability needs are [details].
prompt_templates.scenario: Select a platform for a new automation project.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Durable Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a workflow for [process]. Define triggers, ordered steps, checkpoints, retries, timeouts, idempotency controls, failure handling, and observability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a business process into a reliable workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Review Workflow Reliability
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this workflow design: [design]. Identify duplicate side effects, missing timeouts, unsafe replay behavior, weak retries, large state, and missing alerts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Find reliability risks before production deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Orchestration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production architecture for [system]. Include worker boundaries, event contracts, concurrency, recovery, dead letters, observability, testing, migration, and operational ownership.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan an advanced workflow system across multiple services.

output_examples.input: Design a reliable daily inventory synchronization workflow.
output: Trigger: Run every 15 minutes with one active execution per supplier.
Steps: Fetch changes, validate records, store a checkpoint, apply updates, and publish results.
Controls: Use stable idempotency keys, bounded retries, request timeouts, and a dead letter path.
Operations: Alert on final failure and record supplier, checkpoint, attempt, and error details.

output_examples.input: Review an order workflow that retries payment and email steps.
output: Payment risk: Retries can duplicate charges without an order-based idempotency key.
Email risk: Retries can send repeated confirmations without a sent-status check.
Recovery: Add exponential backoff, final-failure alerts, and a manual review queue.

best_practices: Use stable idempotency keys for every retryable operation that changes external state.
Set explicit timeouts, bounded retries, exponential backoff, and failure handlers.
Keep steps small, checkpoint progress, and store large payloads outside workflow state.
anti_patterns: Do not perform payments, email sends, or database writes outside durable step boundaries.
Do not use random values or current system time in replayed workflow logic.
Do not deploy production workflows without alerts, dead letter handling, and recovery procedures.

faq.question: Which workflow platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers n8n, Temporal, Inngest, AWS Step Functions, and Azure Durable Functions.

faq.question: Can it help choose a platform?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares platforms by accessibility, durability, developer experience, cloud integration, and common use cases.

faq.question: Does it generate deployable workflows?
faq.answer: It provides patterns and examples. You must adapt and test them for your platform, application, credentials, and production environment.

faq.question: How does it prevent duplicate side effects?
faq.answer: It recommends stable idempotency keys, deduplication checks, replay-safe boundaries, and database conflict handling.

faq.question: Does it cover workflow failures?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers retries, exponential backoff, timeouts, heartbeats, alerts, dead letter handling, and manual recovery.

faq.question: Can it review an existing workflow?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the workflow design and platform context to receive a focused reliability and recovery review.
